[Thinking]
**Determining odd number sums**

I need to check if the odd numbers in the set 15, 32, 5, 13, 82, 7, 1 sum to an even number. The odd numbers are 15, 5, 13, 7, and 1, and their sum is 41. So, when I say, "Adding all the odd numbers (15, 5, 13, 7, 1) gives 41," that means the statement about their sum being even is false. I double-checked the arithmetic, and everything adds up correctly!
[/Thinking]

A: Adding all the odd numbers (15, 5, 13, 7, 1) gives 41. The answer is False.
